optics_page.title: OPTICS DIVISION
optics_page.intro: We design and manufacture night vision and thermal imaging systems for military, law enforcement, and civilian operators.

range_page.title: RANGE SOLUTIONS
range_page.intro: From concept to completion — we design, build, and outfit gun ranges for commercial, government, and private clients.
range_page.step_consultation_desc: Site assessment, requirements gathering, feasibility analysis, and project scoping.
range_page.step_design_desc: Architectural layout, lane configuration, ventilation systems, and safety engineering.
range_page.step_construction_desc: Full build-out, equipment installation, ballistic containment, and infrastructure.
range_page.step_outfitting_desc: Target systems, lighting, sound dampening, technology integration, and finishing.
range_page.step_launch_desc: Staff training, program setup, certifications, and grand opening support.
range_page.programs_description: We don't just build your range — we make it operational. Every training program we offer is available as part of your range package.
range_page.programs_addon: Already have a range? We can develop custom programs for your existing facility.

training_page.title: TRAINING PROGRAMS
training_page.intro: Expert-led, in-person training programs designed for operators at every skill level. All programs available standalone or bundled with a Breaker range build.
training_page.long_range_desc: Precision rifle training covering fundamentals through advanced long-range engagements. Ballistics, wind reading, positional shooting, and field craft.
training_page.pistol_desc: Comprehensive pistol platform training from basic marksmanship through advanced defensive and tactical shooting.
training_page.custom_desc: Custom training programs tailored to your organization or facility. Curriculum design, instructor staffing, and ongoing program management.

about_page.title: ABOUT BREAKER TACTICAL
about_page.story_p1: Breaker Tactical Solutions was founded by a team of combat veterans and defense industry engineers with a singular mission: to build the tools and training infrastructure that operators depend on when the stakes are highest.
about_page.story_p2: From our origins designing night vision systems for special operations forces, we expanded into range construction and training — recognizing that the best equipment is only as effective as the facility and instruction behind it.
about_page.story_p3: Today, we operate across two divisions — Optics and Range & Training — serving military, law enforcement, and civilian customers worldwide.
about_page.mission: To equip, train, and empower those who protect and serve — with optics they trust, ranges they rely on, and training that makes the difference.
about_page.value_precision_desc: Every product, every build, every round downrange — precision is non-negotiable.
about_page.value_integrity_desc: We stand behind our work. If it carries the Breaker name, it meets Breaker standards.
about_page.value_innovation_desc: We push the boundaries of what's possible in optical engineering and facility design.
about_page.value_service_desc: Founded by those who served. Built for those who serve. That commitment never changes.
about_page.why_1: Vertically integrated — we design, manufacture, build, and train
about_page.why_2: Combat-proven leadership with decades of operational experience
about_page.why_3: Every training program available standalone or bundled with range builds
about_page.why_4: ISO certified manufacturing and OSHA-compliant construction standards
